market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. Banks provide floor support but housing credit contraction and RBA hike risk cap upside. Oil >$90 supports energy but broadens inflation fears. Expect volatility around RBA communications.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Productivity crisis and near-recession GDP constrain earnings growth. Energy transition cost overhang and housing correction risk weigh on structural returns. Mining exploration and rare earths offer selective alpha. RBA likely to pause or cut if recession materialises, supporting a late-cycle recovery.
